notes.title: 0.8.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
New
• More rings!
• Fish!

Improved
• Items to run into show particles now
• Quests and leaderboards are now in the same modal
• Notification badge when quests are complete
• Juicier quest completion

Fixed
• Random trees appearing in path
• Camera getting jittery when going fast
• Quest cell not showing progress sometimes
• Spikes triggering inconsistently

notes.title: 0.7.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
New
• Quests modal now shows race placements
• Earn an egg every time you level up
• Eggs can now appear in races
• Encounters can now appear between races

Improved
• Better kill zone positioning underneath gameplay area
• More polished particles throughout

Fixed
• Claim reward cell showing glitchy rabbit sometimes

notes.title: 0.6.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
New
- Run into items quests
- Player banner now shows current level and progress
- Added a simple tutorial for new players
- 3 more music tracks added

Improved
- Opponents' ring particles now fade out
- Added more space to the bottom of the screen before being eliminated
- Time until next quest is now shown
- Lava/water textures
- Performance improvements and various UI adjustments

Fixed
- Starting platform intersecting with first chunk
- Continue button not tappable on first try
- "GO!" text wrapping in some languages
- Ring sounds and particles not playing when dying
